items.title: Truist Financial (TFC) Names Two Senior Banking Leaders
items.summary: Truist Financial (NYSE:TFC) has named Harold Ford Jr. vice chair in its Wholesale Banking business. The bank has also appointed Shirley Morejon as Tennessee regional president, expanding its regional leadership bench. Both roles are aimed at accelerating business growth, deepening client relationships, and strengthening commercial banking integration. items.summary: Investing.com -- Anthropic is the hardest U.S. technology company to recruit employees away from, according to AI recruitment specialist JC Christian, who shared his rankings during a Truist Securities investor call.

items.title: Truist, Fifth Third pause products tied to Mark Walter firm amid probe
items.summary: Investing.com -- Truist Financial (NYSE) and Fifth Third Bancorp (NASDAQ) have paused distribution of products tied to billionaire Mark Walter’s Delaware Life Insurance as a U.S. federal investigation puts growing pressure on his investment empire, Bloomberg reported Friday.

items.title: Truist Names Harold Ford Jr. as Adviser
items.summary: Truist Financial named a former U.S. congressman, Harold Ford Jr., as a vice chairman and strategic adviser.  Ford has worked in banking and finance since departing the House of Representatives in 2007, most recently at PNC Financial Services Group.
